nl: How many calls did we make last month?
why_ambiguous: Two metrics plausibly match 'calls': call_count (all logged calls) and sales_calls (converted calls). The catalog descriptions distinguish them; the question does not.
'last month' has no dimension to bind to — the catalog has no month/date/time dimension.

tempting_wrong_selection.why_wrong: Silently picks call_count over sales_calls AND invents a 'month' dimension/filter that does not exist on any model (describe_model('rep_activity') exposes neither). A naive agent executes this; the compiler would reject the unknown dimension, but the metric ambiguity would pass silently and return a confident wrong number for the other reading.

nl: What is the total revenue by country?

aggregate_exprs: SUM(TRY_CAST(CAST(AMOUNT_USD AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE)) AS total_revenue
expected_sql_shape.comment: Clear question: one obvious metric + one compatible dimension. No clarify turn should be added.
